items.original_criterion: Derives the exact weighted squared-norm formula for arbitrary χ, including absence of cross terms without assuming ψ_λ orthogonal, and the sine expression; partial credit for the correct complex-exponential formula alone.
items.interpretation: A fully derived weighted complex-exponential, cosine or sine formula earns full credit for the norm-identity criterion when label orthogonality and elimination of cross terms are justified. An unexplained formula may earn partial credit; omission of sine normal form alone is not an error.
items.reason: The question asks for an exact formula and does not prescribe its algebraic normal form. The weighted exponential, cosine and sine expressions are equal under the given normalized weights.
